text:
ben: Postmortem action items from INC-3245 focused on recurring cache-eviction spikes during autoscale. Goal for this thread: claim owners for runbook edits, triage commands, and remediation timelines. I sketched a compact plan below.

maya: I can take the runbook edits and the short checklist snippet.

toni: I9ll own PagerDuty rules + escalation wording and follow through on testing the PD policy.

ben: Proposed short checklist (copy into docs/ops/runbooks/cache-evictions.md exactly):
1) evidence: collect recent events (kubectl -n infra get events --field-selector reason=Evicted --sort-by=.lastTimestamp --all-namespaces --since=1h)
2) logs: kubectl -n infra logs -l app=cache --tail=400 | egrep -i "evict|oom|killed"
3) metrics: redwood-metrics query "sum(increase(redis_evictions[5m])) by (shard)"
4) resource snapshot: kubectl top pods -n infra --containers && kubectl describe node $NODE | sed -n '1,120p'
5) autoscaler trace: kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/cluster-autoscaler --since=2h | egrep -i "scale|resource request|failed"
6) preserve: tarball pod logs + metrics to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/inc-3245/{{date}}/ and add README with commands run.

maya: Also add a quick escalation-first step: if redis latency > 500ms and redis_evictions increase by >0 in 5m, page oncall and create evidence bundle.

toni: PD rule I propose: page oncall immediately for first eviction alert; if a second eviction occurs within 15 minutes, escalate to infra lead and open a high-priority incident channel. I will add JSON for PD policy and paste into runbook. ACTION-6002 created (owner: toni) due 2310007200.

ops-bot: ACTION-6001 created: owner=maya due=2310005400

ben: Owners + deadlines (draft):
- maya: update docs/ops/runbooks/cache-evictions.md with checklist + paste commands (ACTION-6001) due 2310005400
- toni: add PagerDuty escalation policy + play text into runbook (ACTION-6002) due 2310007200
- ben: coordinate a controlled scale test plan and submit a test ticket to infra (ACTION-6003) due 2310060000

maya: I'll add verbatim commands and an example evidence README to the PR. Note: include ACTION IDs in PR body and link to INC-3245.

ben: For the controlled test: we want an incremental scale that simulates bursty traffic to cache and validates if the autoscaler decision led to node pressure -> eviction. If test reproduces, follow-up is to tune burst settings and pod disruptive settings.

ops-bot: Reminder: cluster-autoscaler logs are only retained 7d; consider increasing retention if we need postmortem correlation. ACTION-6004 suggested.

oncall: Acknowledged. If paged I9ll run the checklist and upload artifacts to the evidence bucket, then paste links here.

maya: Opening PR now for docs/ops/runbooks/cache-evictions.md, will tag @toni and @ben and include ACTION-6001 in description.

incidents-bot: ACTION-6001 status: in_progress (owner: maya); ACTION-6002 status: open (owner: toni); ACTION-6003 status: open (owner: ben).

ben: Scheduling a 15m follow-up next Tue to confirm runbook merged and PD rules deployed. If any owner needs more time, flag it in this thread before EOD today.

maya: noted, will update if timeline slips.

toni: will validate PD JSON in staging and report back here.
